g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters Interpolating request-controlled text into a SQL statement lets an attacker alter the query — exfiltrating or modifying arbitrary rows, bypassing authentication, or escalating to full database control. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication An unauthenticated attacker posts a victim's email, a guessed security answer and a new password to /rest/user/reset-password. A correct answer resets the password with no out-of-band check, no rate limit and no notice to the owner. C-09 · Authentication & Session Surface No account required No weakness linked in the register Full account takeover through guessable or researchable answers, with unlimited guesses. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access A signed-in attacker puts another user's ID into the owner field of the request (req.body.UserId and the like); the query trusts it instead of the session identity, so the attacker reads or changes every other user's records — horizontal privilege escalation across all accounts. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server Regular account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-002) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets A request-controlled path with `../` can read arbitrary files (/etc/passwd, source, secrets) or write outside the intended root. C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors User input evaluated as server code Log in and POST /profile with username=#{process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id')} C-01 · Juice Shop Express Server No account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-003) Remote code execution in the Node process. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: User input evaluated as server code

g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers Token exfiltrated from local/session storage via the Step 1 payload. C-05 · Angular Frontend Victim interaction required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests The Google login builds a response_type=token request with no state, nonce or PKCE, and the redirect_uri is not URL-encoded. An attacker can feed a victim a token or redirect of their own, causing login CSRF or session confusion. C-05 · Angular Frontend Victim interaction required OAuth sign-in requests are not bound to the user's browser session (W-021) Cookie-authenticated changes lack request authenticity checks (W-022) Attacker-controlled OAuth responses may be accepted, binding the victim to an attacker-chosen identity, and access tokens appear in URL fragments. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Missing Container Image Signing: Unsigned container images cannot be verified for provenance — any registry intermediary could substitute them. C-03 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-008) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data Disclosure of customer information
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
